firstShown.explanation: Use a conditional invariant: retained buffered bytes are exactly the current unterminated line, excluding LF and excluding discarded overflow bytes. Complete lines are decoded and validated before transactional state changes; invalid lines increment errors and clear the open transaction.
firstShown.mapping: The rule maps each event to buffered length, while open, visible, and errors are updated only by validated frames, overflow, or finish recovery.
firstShown.assumptions: Inputs obey the public event and config domains. JSON frame objects must have exactly the documented keys; imported values are scalar and safe.
firstShown.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;let b=0,d=false,m=input.config.maxBytes;for(let i=0;i<output.length;i++){let e=input.events[i];if(e.type==='chunk'){for(let x of e.bytes){if(d){if(x===10)d=false}else if(x===10)b=0;else if(++b>m){b=0;d=true}}}else if(e.type==='finish'){b=0;d=false}if(output[i].buffered!==b)return false}return true}
